(rule!
  (let* ((target (first (sort (objects g 0)
                              (lambda (a b)
                                (let ((wa (obj-w a)) (wb (obj-w b)))
                                  (if (= wa wb) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)) (> wa wb)))))))
         ;; Bounding box (r1 c1 r2 c2) of target
         (bb (obj-bbox target)))
    (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
